objections.reply: A single successful ransomware or BEC incident often costs more than a year of protection. Basic starts at KES 12,900/month for foundational controls. We can also start with a free consultation and prioritise the highest-risk gaps first.

objections.objection: We are too small to be targeted
objections.reply: Attackers often prefer smaller organisations because defences are weaker. Kenyan SMEs are routinely hit by phishing, BEC, and ransomware. Size does not equal safety.

Classic antivirus alone is not enough against modern phishing, cloud account takeover, and ransomware. Packages combine endpoint protection, email controls, monitoring, and response — the layers that actually stop real incidents.

objections.objection: Can we try before we commit?
objections.reply: Yes. Start with a free consultation. We review your situation and recommend practical next steps with no obligation.
Packages are modular starting points. For custom scopes (extra sites, special compliance, larger environments), book a consultation and we design a fit-for-purpose stack.

local_threats.name: Business Email Compromise (BEC)
local_threats.description: Attackers impersonate directors or suppliers and request urgent payments or bank detail changes. Very common in Kenya.
local_threats.impact: Direct financial loss — often from tens of thousands to millions of KES

local_threats.name: Mobile Money & SIM-Swap Fraud
local_threats.description: Social engineering or SIM swap to take over M-Pesa or bank-linked numbers.
local_threats.impact: Immediate loss of funds and account takeover

local_threats.name: Ransomware targeting SMEs
local_threats.description: Files encrypted; attackers demand crypto payment. SMEs and schools are frequent targets.
local_threats.impact: Downtime, data loss, recovery cost, possible regulatory issues

local_threats.name: Phishing & fake invoices
local_threats.description: Emails and WhatsApp messages mimicking banks, KRA, suppliers, or internal staff.

local_threats.name: Insider threats & access abuse
local_threats.description: Careless or malicious use of access; former staff retaining credentials.

case_studies.solution: Incident response, restore from clean backups, deploy XDR and ongoing monitoring.
case_studies.outcome: Recovery within about 18 hours. No ransom paid. Moved to Standard Protection.

faq.q: How fast do you respond to critical incidents?
faq.a: Critical incidents on Standard and Premium packages target response under 15 minutes during monitored coverage. 24/7 SOC is included on Standard and Premium.

faq.q: Do you do on-site support in Kisumu?
faq.a: Yes. Remote support is primary; on-site is available in Kisumu and surrounding areas when needed.
Yes. A free 20–30 minute consultation to understand risks and recommend practical next steps — no obligation.

faq.q: Do you support Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace?
faq.a: Yes. We harden both, implement MFA, improve collaboration security, and monitor where the package includes it.

Basic = foundation (firewall, EDR baseline, email basics, business-hours support). Standard = adds 24/7 SOC, stronger XDR/cloud/email, priority response (most popular). Premium = adds quarterly pentests, dedicated contact, IR retainer, executive briefings.
Primarily Lipa na M-Pesa from the Packages page (STK prompt on your phone). Bank transfer available on request. Never share your PIN in chat.

faq.q: Can we change or cancel later?
faq.a: Monthly packages. Changes and notice periods follow our Terms of Service — typically 30 days written notice for termination of monthly packages.

faq.q: Do you guarantee we will never be breached?
faq.a: No honest provider can. We reduce risk significantly with layered controls and fast response. Absolute guarantees are marketing fiction.
